newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Coffee seen holding above support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Coffee seen holding above support.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures should hold above nearby support for the time being although there is still room for the benchmark November contract to rack up further light losses, technical analysts said on Friday.
November is still facing heavy overhead resistance after a sharp slide earlier in the week left a $30 gap between $1,650 and $1,680, extending above an area of supply at around $1,670.

"$1,650 is the first resistance and then $1,680 and it's unlikely to get over the latter part," said Elli Gifford, a technical analyst at Investment Research in Cambridge. "It could go lower but I suspect the support will hold."

More near-term support is likely to come from December's 20-day moving average, which at $1,610 is immediately below current levels, followed by a convergence of the 30- and 40-day averages at $1,572.
"The considerable supply over $1,700 has forced retreats and there is a very strong likelihood we have seen the highs for now," Gifford said in Investment Research's latest technical summary.
Traders called the market to open unchanged from Thursday's close.
